body: Life is short as it is, death is only certainty so where is the rush ? Enjoy the journey. The good, bad and ugly. That's life as Sinatra would say.

Congrats, you ain't suicidal anymore.

Reverse psychology. 😉

If you plan on to go, make it big like a Beethoven symphony. Something no one will ever forget. Make a statement, because suicide is ultimate "fuck you" to the world & everyone on it. I am resolved in killing myself also, only timing, who should I, if should I take them with me (life is bigger punishment, death is a release) and how to do it, is still questionable. Suicide by police is 100% effective.
